head: codex/5610-coverage-path-normalization
title: [v0.91.8][CI][coverage] Normalize safe in-repo coverage paths
body:
Closes #5610

Normalizes slash-unified llvm-cov filenames with platform-independent POSIX lexical semantics before owned-source matching. Safe in-root `bin/..` paths canonicalize, while repository-prefix and owned-root traversal escapes fail closed.

Focused FastWork proof passed: coverage-summary merge contract, coupled CI runtime contract, authoritative coverage-lane contract, Python compilation, and diff hygiene. Exact-head bounded review found no issues. Provenance, metric validation, duplicate rejection, total recomputation, atomic output, and coverage gates are unchanged.

Issue #5602 terminal truth remains immutable; consumer PR #5607 and PR #5608 branches are untouched.
